clips.title: The story
paras: The Candle of Beckoning is an enchanted ritual taper kept by the reclusive necromancer Gunther Arcanus on Brightwater Lake. Placing and lighting the candle upon an altar on a nearby islet summons forth a restless spirit known as Lillith Nefara.

Found stored in a crate beside the solitary mage Gunther Arcanus on his island in Brightwater Lake, the Candle of Beckoning serves as an instrument in a dark ritual of summoning. Gunther is a fiercely independent undead sorcerer who broke free of the Lich King's command on his own, remaining wary of the Scourge and the Forsaken alike. To prove your loyalty is not to the Lich King, Gunther directs you to take one of these candles southwest to a smaller islet. There, set upon an old, bloodstained table, the candle's flame pierces the veil between worlds to awaken and beckon the dormant shade of Lillith Nefara, a powerful Scourge agent, so she may be destroyed.
